description: createModel() rerouted off the configured primary provider to the fallback because model-health judged the primary degraded (mastra.span.type = model_failover). This is telemetry-driven failover firing: the app read its OWN error-rate/p95 back out of SigNoz (or hit a local error burst) and protected the turn on its own. A failover is not itself an outage — the request succeeded on the fallback — but it means the primary provider is unhealthy RIGHT NOW and every turn is paying the fallback's price/latency until it recovers. Check the primary provider's status, then the llm-latency-p95 / tool-call-failures rules and the model_generation error spans for gen_ai.provider.name = the primary. The trigger is in model.failover.source: local = this pod's recent error burst, signoz = a fleet-wide regression, forced = a demo/override toggle (MODEL_HEALTH_FORCE_DEGRADED).

filter.expression: service.name = 'casper-assistant' AND deployment.environment.name = 'production' AND mastra.span.type = 'model_failover' AND casper.self_instrumented = true

annotations.description: The configured primary provider is degraded; requests are running on the fallback ({{$labels.model_failover_to}}) until it recovers. Inspect the primary provider's health.
